tools.name: get_supplier_capabilities
tools.description: Returns Reqo's supported categories, accepted inputs, and the quote-to-order flow available over this server.

tools.name: submit_rfq
tools.description: Submits a parts list for a wholesale quote and returns an rfq_id. Poll get_quote(rfq_id) until status is 'ready'. Non-binding; no charge occurs at this step.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Returns the current state of a quote. status is 'pending' while it is being priced, 'ready' once priced (with total and line pricing), 'accepted' once ordered, or 'expired'.

tools.name: accept_quote
tools.description: Accepts a 'ready' quote. Returns an order_id and a secure payment link the buyer completes to place the order. Accepting a quote whose payment is settled confirms the order.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Returns whether an order is awaiting payment or paid, its amount, and the invoice link. Fulfillment updates are added to the record as they occur.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "submit_rfq" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: lines, buyer_email, company, contact_name, ship_to_zip, needed_by, context, account_number
